import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['late']=w.year>=1876; w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack().dropna(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
e=est(w);rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
grp={k:v.r.values for k,v in w.groupby(['genre','late'])}
G=sorted(set(k[0] for k in grp))
for i in range(4000):
  bs.append(np.mean([rng.choice(grp[(g,True)],len(grp[(g,True)])).mean()-rng.choice(grp[(g,False)],len(grp[(g,False)])).mean() for g in G]))
print(e,np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.agg(['mean','size']).to_string())
for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc, est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
print('excl1866-85',est(w[(w.year<1866)|(w.year>=1886)]))
print('1850-1900',est(w[(w.year>=1850)&(w.year<1900)]))
print('single ed',est(w[w.n_editions==1]))
print(w.groupby(['origin','late']).r.mean().unstack())
# author clustering: one per author
print('authors',w.author_key.nunique())
a=w.groupby('author_key').size(); print(a.describe())
p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
ids=w[(w[c]>0)].merge(p[['passage_id','work_id','confidence']],on='work_id')
print(ids.sort_values('confidence',ascending=False)[['passage_id','year','genre','confidence']].head(8))
"

def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack().dropna(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
A=w.author_key.unique();rng=np.random.default_rng(1);gb={a:d for a,d in w.groupby('author_key')};bs=[]

  bs.append(est(pd.concat([gb[a] for a in rng.choice(A,len(A))])))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
top=w.author_key.value_counts().index[:20]; print('drop top authors',est(w[~w.author_key.isin(top)]))
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,est(w[w.origin==o]))
